description: Class representing a custom XML node.

Add.description: Creates a child node for the current XML node.

params.description: The name of the new child node.
params.name: nodeName

returns.description: Returns `true` if the node was successfully deleted.

DeleteAttribute.description:
Deletes an attribute from the custom XML node.
If the attribute exists, it will be removed.

params.description: The name of the attribute to delete.
params.name: name

returns.description: Returns `true` if the attribute was successfully deleted, `false` if the attribute didn't exist.

GetAttribute.description:
Retrieves the attribute value from the custom XML node.
If the attribute doesn't exist, it returns `false`.

params.description: The name of the attribute to retrieve.
params.name: name

returns.description: The value of the attribute if it exists, or `null` if the attribute is not found.

GetAttributes.description: Returns a list of attributes of the current XML node.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiCustomXmlNode class.

GetNodeName.description: Returns the name of the current XML node.

returns.description: The name of the current node.

GetNodeValue.description: Returns the XML string representation of the current node content.

returns.description: The XML string representation of the current node content.

GetNodes.description: Returns nodes from the custom XML node based on the given XPath.

params.description: The XPath expression to match nodes.
params.name: xPath

returns.description: An array of nodes that match the given XPath.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent of the current XML node.

returns.description: The parent node, or `null` if the current node has no parent.

GetText.description:
Returns the inner text of the current node and its child nodes.
For example: `<text>123<one>4</one></text>` returns `"1234"`.

returns.description: The combined text content of the node and its descendants.

GetXPath.description: Returns the absolute XPath of the current XML node.

returns.description: The absolute XPath of the current node.

GetXml.description: Returns the XML string of the current node.

returns.description: The XML string representation of the current node.

SetAttribute.description:
Sets an attribute for the custom XML node.
If the attribute already exists, it will not be modified.

params.description: The name of the attribute to set.
params.name: name

params.description: The value to assign to the attribute.
params.name: value

returns.description: Returns `true` if the attribute was successfully set, `false` if the attribute already exists.

SetNodeValue.description: Sets the XML content for the current node.

params.description: The XML string to set as the content of the current node.
params.name: xml

returns.description: Returns `true` if the XML was successfully set.

SetText.description: Sets the text content of the current XML node.

params.description: The text content to set for the node.
params.name: str

returns.description: Returns `true` if the text was successfully set.

SetXml.description: Sets the XML content of the current XML node.

params.description: The XML string to set as the node content.
params.name: strXml

returns.description: Returns `true` if the XML was successfully set.

UpdateAttribute.description:
Updates the value of an existing attribute in the custom XML node.
If the attribute doesn't exist, the update will not occur.

params.description: The name of the attribute to update.
params.name: name

params.description: The new value to assign to the attribute.
params.name: value

returns.description: Returns `true` if the attribute was successfully updated, `false` if the attribute doesn't exist.
